description:
Survey scripts under `dev/active/` name evidence directories, tarballs and launchers under `dev/bench_results/` by literal path, the named exception `evidence-directory-paths` to `@/inv/no-dev-path-coupling`. The artifacts carry no identity in their bytes, and the literals are written into recorded output.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each survey script locates its evidence directories through one runtime-resolved repository root and an identity or an explicit argument, with no literal `dev/` path.
- [hard] REQ-02: Recorded outputs of the scripts on committed inputs are unchanged, or the change is recorded with the receipts it affects.
- [hard] REQ-03: The exception record states that the exception has ended.
title: Converge survey-script evidence paths on runtime-resolved locations
